items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 102:1
items.html: The screen of phase three is discerned by the name a narrow window. And when ZA receives the illumination of Hochma, he receives it through this screen. And it is called a narrow window, because it is narrow in Hassadim and long in Hochma; that is, it is the discernment of the Yesod of Abba, which is completely lacking the imparting of Hassadim, and there is in it only the light of Hochma without Hassadim. And the imparting of Hassadim is called wide, and the imparting of Hochma is called long, as is known. (Item 30).
